newsitem.title: BRUNEI: Brunei appoints deputy finance minister. [CORRECTED 08:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brunei appoints deputy finance minister. [CORRECTED 08:40 GMT]

text.p: Brunei Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah has appointed a Harvard-trained bureaucrat as deputy finance minister following the resignation of the Sultan's younger brother as head of the ministry.

Selamat Munap, who was the deputy minister of culture, youth and sports, took over the deputy's job at the finance ministry on April 1, the government said late on Wednesday. The Brunei ruler, who is also Prime Minister and Defence Minister, took over the finance portfolio as well, after his younger brother Jefri Bolkiah resigned for personal reasons in February.

The finance ministry now has two deputies, but the current deputy, Ahmad Wally Skinner, is 72 (corrects age from 75) and in poor health, diplomats said. Selamat earned a degree in economics from Canada's McGill University and then obtained a Master's degree in business from Harvard University. He was previously a director in Brunei's Economic Development Board, director of education and permanent secretary in the prime minister's office.
Brunei last month issued its 1996-2000 five-year development plan which outlines plans for the tiny oil sultanate's economy to be less dependent on petroleum and move into tourism and trade services.
